recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. issue_request: Published/Persuasive DSTU1 ballot comment asking that overview-dev section 1.9.1.2 not be headed "Example: Patient" and instead use a generic resource-oriented heading because the patient example introduced general resource attributes.
initial_application: The Jira comment records SVN revision 4511. In git, 11694a1c4b (#5225 - clarification) is that git-svn application and changed source/overview-dev.html from "Example Patient" to "Example Resource", with a small JSON/XML link clarification.
additional_context: overview-dev.html remains in current build scope through publish.ini and source/hierarchy.xml. A later FHIR-11033 source commit clarified resource instances versus resource types and changed the heading to "Example Resource Instance" while preserving the generic framing. Direct Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the current heading is generic, no longer patient-specific, and accurately identifies the section as an example resource instance.

related_jiras.note: Later clarification of resource instances versus resource types explains why the current heading says "Example Resource Instance"; it was context only and was not separately decided.
